Meta.title: Pickeed – See what’s on and go with your friends.
Meta.description: Follow friends, creators and places in your city. And when something grabs you, one tap turns it into a plan.

hero.lead: Follow friends, creators and places in your city. And when something grabs you, one tap turns it into a plan.
hero.friends: Your friends join via a link. No account needed.
hero.phonesLabel: Pickeed on a phone: this week’s Top Picks, home with Circle and an event with “I’m in”.
hero.claim: Social media that gets you out with friends.

s1.title: Follow and discover
s1.text: Photos, status updates and events from friends, creators and companies – you see what’s on.

s2.title: See who’s going
s2.text: “4 friends are going” – one tap and you’re in.

s3.title: It becomes a plan
s3.text: Date, place, who brings what: Pickeed turns “Who’s coming?” into the plan – you confirm with one tap.

topPicks.title: Your city’s top 10
topPicks.text: Top Picks show what guests enjoyed: rated by guests who were there. New every Monday – and nobody can buy their way in.
topPicks.sub: Your city’s top 10 – new every week, based on guest ratings.

plan.title: A plan in one sentence
plan.text: Just write what you have in mind. Pickeed turns it into a plan with time, place and costs – you confirm with one tap.

demo.title: How it works
demo.intro: A pasta night with four friends – from the first «When?» to the booked table.
demo.label: Example in three steps

time.title: Find a date
time.text: Pickeed suggests a date. Everyone says «Works» or «Not a fit» – if it doesn’t work, the next one comes straight away.

idea.title: Decide together
idea.text: Everyone can suggest, everyone votes. The group sees at once which restaurant is ahead.

ready.title: Plan is set
ready.text: When, where and who’s coming – in one place. Who books the table is in there too.

demo.ask: Does Friday, 7 pm work for you?

features.title: Everything you need, in one app.

denktmit.title: Pickeed thinks ahead
denktmit.text: Date, place, who brings what: Pickeed suggests, you confirm with one tap. Less back and forth, more time together.

zusagen.title: Friends say yes
zusagen.text: I’m in, Maybe or Not – with one tap. Vote, split costs and chat in the same plan. Friends join via link, even without an account.

circle.title: Who’s free today?
circle.text: Circle shows who has time. Set your status, and “free today” turns into a spontaneous evening.

entdecken.title: Discover and events
entdecken.text: Concerts, workshops and runs near you. Tap “I’m in” and you’re on the list – free tickets arrive in the app with a QR code.

memories.title: Your next memory starts here.
memories.text: After you meet, share photos in the plan – moments that stay. Videos coming soon.

qr.title: Got Pickeed?
qr.text: Skip swapping numbers: show your code, scan, connected – in two seconds.

profile.title: Make your profile yours.
profile.lead: Colour, music, moments and your people – friends see at a glance what you’re about and when you’re free.

farbe.title: Your colour
farbe.text: Pick a profile colour: the ring, buttons and header show your shade.

song.title: Your favourite song
song.text: Your song sits on your profile. Friends tap once to hear a 30-second preview.

sticker.title: A song for your post
sticker.text: Add a song to your photo – so the moment keeps playing.

status.title: Status and highlights
status.text: Show what’s on today. Your best status updates stay on your profile as highlights.

frei.title: Free today?
frei.text: One tap tells friends you’ve got time today – and you see who else is free.

leute.title: My people
leute.text: Your closest friends right at the top of your profile. Tap a picture to open their profile.

invitee.title: Your friends only need the link
invitee.lead: This is what Mia sees when she taps your link in WhatsApp.
invitee.p1: Tap the link – from WhatsApp, a text message or a QR code.
invitee.p2: Enter a first name. No account, no email, no password.
invitee.p3: Join in straight away: tap «Works», vote, chat.
invitee.name: What’s your name?
invitee.noAccount: The others only see your first name.

i1.title: An evening with friends
i1.text: Pasta, cinema or drinks: find a date, vote on the place, done.

i2.title: Birthday
i2.text: Invite guests, share a wish list, chip in for a present – as a surprise if you like.

i3.title: Team event
i3.text: One date for the whole team, sign-ups and tasks – without the email ping-pong.

business.title: People who actually show up.
business.text: A profile with cover pictures, followers, guest ratings, free tickets with QR code, honest stats and your own team – without selling data.

privacy.title: Your data stays yours.
privacy.text: No banner ads, no tracking, no data sold. Chats are only seen by the people in them.
privacy.free: Company spaces and public events are free too – the provider plan and the ticket service fee are free until {date}.

final.title: Your next plan is waiting.
final.text: In your browser, no download. Free for you.
